searchText: Stuff that needs Change control probably should live somewhere else. I just went through my difficulty bomb EIP and moved more of how I got to my reasoning into the Discussion thread. It seemed like a good fit. for most things it seems like that information can exist on the discussion thread. If it needs more and more that may be a good sign its grown outside what the EIP process should manage. And should probably have its own maintainers who aren't EIP-editors. Then again I still pretty much live on the Core-EIP side so how the ERC side works could be different. <@!543900561460822016> https://github.com/MadeofTin/EIPs/blob/patch-20/EIPS/eip-3554.md I resolved all of Micahs responses Would be great to get this merged for the comming discussion next week. Re: ^ One more note <@!187490121698770945> (see PR). looking oops missed the link got it thanks 🥳
